safety_notice: CostGuard-X operates strictly as a read-only advisory and cost-intelligence system. No automated changes or infrastructure modifications are made.
guiding_principles: Advisory Only: Never execute CLI / SDK commands that modify, stop, or delete AWS resources.
Human-in-the-Loop: All waste recommendations require manual review by cloud engineers or FinOps specialists.
Production Safeguards: Never recommend aggressive downsizing for production resources without 14 days of metrics.
Conservative Counterfactuals: Always label cost savings as estimates based on historical usage assumptions.
